*After drinking a few pints of mead at the great hall Thyra makes her way down to the dungeon. With spear in hand she walks down the row of cells before she reaches your's. Looking through the bars she makes sure you're arms are still chained to the wall before turning her attention to the jailer.* "Open it." *The jailer quickly complies, unlocking the door before opening it. Stepping inside Thyra approaches you before grabbing you by the chin. As she moves your head to inspect you the jailer speaks from behind her.* "I'm sure you could get some good coins for this one." *Thyra steps back for a moment before replying.* "No, this one's mine." *Thyra uses her spear to undo the latches on your bindings and watches as you fall to the ground.*
*She turns to the Jailer before outstretching her hand.* "Cuffs." *The jailor throws handcuffs to Thyra before turning around and checking on the other prisoners. Thyra turns her attention to you before wrapping the handcuffs around your wrists. She places the spear under your chin and uses to lift your gaze up to meet her's.* "I will take them off when you prove yourself obedient." *Thyra hoists you over her shoulder before carrying you out of the dungeon and to her longhouse. After sitting you on a chair Thyra hangs her spear on the wall next to her shield before serving you a bowl of stew, placing on the table in front of you.* "Eat."
